biggest_catch: You must submit the rebate application within 60 days of the date on your paid-in-full invoice — miss that window and you get nothing.
catches: Applications must be submitted within 60 days of the paid-in-full invoice/receipt date.
You must be a Georgia Power residential customer with your meter number handy.
Appliance amounts are stated as 'up to' — the smart thermostat is up to $150.
Some measures require an affiliated program installer; the listed appliances are DIY-eligible.
The qualifying appliance purchase is a condition, not an upfront fee.

steps: Buy a qualifying appliance (washer, dryer, refrigerator, dishwasher, or smart thermostat).
Keep your paid-in-full invoice or receipt and note your Georgia Power meter number.
Submit the HEIP rebate application online within 60 days of the invoice date.
Wait for processing — typically 6–8 weeks for a complete application — then receive your rebate check.

Where the evidence notes an instant in-store / point-of-sale discount alternative, that is same-day savings on the purchase (not cash) — it cannot be stacked with the mail-in rebate.
